title: Taste & Tales – Faster menu screenshot loading on mobile

requirements.summary: Serve optimized menu screenshot assets and prioritize the first above-the-fold image load while keeping loading/error states stable.
acceptanceCriteria: On the /menu page, the first visible menu screenshot uses high fetch priority (e.g., eager load / fetchpriority=high) so it starts downloading immediately when the page is opened.
Menu screenshot assets used on mobile are smaller/optimized versions (reduced dimensions and/or compression) compared to the current originals, while preserving acceptable readability.
MENU_SCREENSHOT_ASSETS is updated to reference the optimized screenshot asset URLs (or uses responsive selection that serves optimized assets on mobile).
The UI continues to show a clear loading state while the image loads and degrades gracefully if an image fails to load (no broken layout).

Update MENU_SCREENSHOT_ASSETS to reference the optimized screenshot URLs (using the new files under frontend/public/assets/generated/) so fewer bytes are transferred on mobile data.

Prioritize above-the-fold screenshot rendering by setting the first screenshot to eager load + high fetch priority, while keeping the existing loading state and improving graceful error fallback (no broken layout). Also add stable sizing attributes to reduce layout shift.

requirements.summary: Add a mobile-targeted preload hint for the first menu screenshot without introducing conflicting head hints or breaking other pages.
acceptanceCriteria: The app includes a preload hint for the first menu screenshot (the first entry in MENU_SCREENSHOT_ASSETS) targeted for mobile viewports where appropriate.
Preload does not introduce console errors or duplicate/conflicting resource hints in the document head.

file_operations.description: Add a single <link rel="preload" as="image"> hint for the first menu screenshot asset (the first entry in MENU_SCREENSHOT_ASSETS), scoped with a mobile media query (e.g., max-width) to avoid unnecessary preloads on desktop and to prevent duplicate/conflicting hints.
